title: AgentSchool curriculum import v1: shared definitions

contractVersion.description: Semantic version of this contract the file was written against. Major must be 1.

id.description: Stable identifier: lower-case kebab-case, ASCII. Never reuse an id for different content; change the content and bump `revision` instead.

subjectId.description: Subject identifier. v1 knows exactly these three subjects.

form.description: Secondary form (tingkatan). v1 covers SPM Forms 4 and 5.

localizedText.description: Plain or rich text in English and/or Bahasa Melayu. At least one language. Rich text: Markdown subset plus inline TeX between single dollar signs, e.g. "Solve $x^2 - 9 = 0$." (see SPEC.md §4).

tex.description: A display-mode TeX expression that must render with KaTeX 0.16 in strict mode. No surrounding $ signs.

board_step.description: One step of a worked explanation, as shown on the classroom blackboard.

source.description: Provenance of the content. Required on every lesson, exercise and document (honest-claims rule).

kind.description: original = written for AgentSchool; adapted = rewritten from a cited source; quoted = reproduced text (needs a licence that allows it); official_reference = only cites official codes/titles, no copied text.

generated_with.description: Set when an AI tool drafted the content (e.g. 'codex'). Drafted content must still be human-reviewed before approval.

review.description: Human review state. Only `approved` content is served to students. Importers treat `approved` as untrusted unless the operator opts in (SPEC.md §7).

relativePath.description: Path inside the bundle, forward slashes, no '..', no leading '/'.
